A [[Gender/Legends|man]] named [[Bellis]] and his wife [[Lin]] lived in a '''house''' in [[Talloran village]] during the [[Separatist War]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. Around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]], Bellis was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Mantellian Separatist Movement|separatists]] and a [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|Republic soldier]] came to the house to retrieve Bellis's [[field box]] which contained information on a missing [[ZR-57 orbital strike bomb]].
